intent_snapshot.goal: Implement S2 of docs/specs/review-settlement-hardening.spec.md: the Claude Review Host binds a reviewer start to a reservation only when the dispatched prompt is byte-identical to the reserved prompt.

acceptance.assertion: Per S2 of docs/specs/review-settlement-hardening.spec.md (BR-REQ-4, BR-DEC-2): when a SubagentStart or the Agent tool input carries a prompt, it binds to a Review reservation only if that prompt equals the reserved dispatch prompt exactly. A prompt that keeps the matching operation_id and task_id marker but appends text, removes text, or rewrites the body does not bind, cannot settle the reservation, and yields a blocked submit_review with the S1 recovery_action; a prompt with a different operation or task marker still does not bind. The byte-identical prompt binds and settles as before, and a start that carries no prompt but an explicit matching operationId binds as before. No marker-only acceptance path remains. Tests cover the exact, appended, truncated, rewritten, foreign-marker and no-prompt controls. The Loop contract states that any edit to the reserved prompt forfeits the reservation. The generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source.

acceptance_results.summary: host-attested QA: all 1 project verification check(s) passed; execution=sha256:f51c9031d90039e6c84070f4ac0dd6c171b325f815eedd330c5d8f2675dda0ab

attestations.summary: Marker-only acceptance is gone: bindsPrompt enforces byte equality against the single reservedDispatchPrompt for both SubagentStart and Agent PostToolUse, the prompt-less explicit-operationId path is preserved, the generated bundle mirrors the runtime, and all six controls are asserted.

advisory_findings.summary: The edited-prompt controls stop at the host result; no test drives submit_review to assert the blocked state plus the retained recovery_action for a non-binding prompt.

evidence.trigger: Dispatch the appended prompt from dispatchWith, then call submitClaudeReview for the reserved task: inspectReviewForTask returns {ok:false, reason:'reserved foreground Agent was not observed', release:false}, which kernel_ports maps to {state:'blocked', recovery_action:RETAINED_REVIEW_RECOVERY}; the mapping is asserted only for the unrelated not-observed case, not composed with the edited-prompt cause.

advisory_findings.summary: The foreign-marker control varies only operation_id; the task_id variant named by the acceptance is covered transitively by the single equality predicate rather than by its own assertion.

evidence.trigger: A prompt keeping operation_id=OPERATION but a rewritten task_id marker still binds nothing, because reservedDispatchPrompt embeds both identifiers in the compared string; no test constructs that input, so a future marker-format change that drops task_id from the reserved string would not be caught by this suite.
